Airframe.description: Airframe construction, independent of takeoff capability.

PhysicalDomain.description: A bounded thing operates in exactly one domain.

Representation.description: How a semantic quantity becomes irreducible data variables.

CLASSIFY.description: Solve for the classification of an entity.

DIRECT.description: Direct the target to a destination or along a path.

HOLD.description: Maintain an actor's position at the destination.

IDENTIFY.description: Solve for the identity of an entity.

LOAD_CONFIGURATION.description: Load a referenced configuration on the target.

LOCATE.description: Solve for the position of an entity.

MEASURE.description: Measure a state of a target.

MOVE.description: Move an actor until its position is the destination.

PROTECT.description: Keep an object in its current state.

REMOVE.description: Make an object cease to exist.

RESET.description: Reset the target to its initial state.

RESTORE.description: Return an object to a prior state.

SET.description: Set a declared state property on the target.

TRACK.description: Maintain awareness of an entity's position.

TRANSPORT.description: Move a thing between places; which end and what moves are bindings.
